issues.issue: Did the officer impose an undue burden by requiring unique, compelling reasons to overcome inadmissibility?
issues.applicant_position: Officer imposed an undue burden requiring unique compelling reasons that the Act does not contain.
issues.result_text: Exceptional and compelling circumstances are required under s.24; 'unique' means the same; no undue burden.

issues.issue: Was the refusal of the temporary resident permit reasonable, given the study and business evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Officer ignored evidence of 2013-2014 courses, status efforts and business contributions; reasons unintelligible.
issues.result_text: Reasons do not adequately explain the basis of the decision; set aside and referred to another officer.
